    ⏱ How Long Until Your First Sale?
    
    
    
      
    
        
    📋 Amazon Review
    
        
    24–72 hours after publish. Amazon reviews every new title before it goes live on the store.
    
      
    
      
    
        
    🔍 Indexing & Discovery
    
        
    Day 3–7. Amazon's algorithm starts indexing your book for keyword searches. Kindle Unlimited exposure begins.
    
      
    
      
    
        
    💰 First Sale
    
        
    Typically day 1–14. With 10 books published daily, you have 10× more chances. More books = faster first sale.
    
      
    
    
    
    
    
      📊 Revenue math: 10 books/day × $2.99 × 70% royalty = $2.09/sale per book.
      Month 1: 300 books live. If 1% sell 1 copy/month = $6.27/month passive.
      Month 3: 900 books. At 2% sell rate = $376/month growing.
      Scales automatically — no extra work.

  -H "X-API-Key: wv_..." \
  -d '{"bot_name":"content_generator","category":"marketing"}'
